$comment: EVIDENCE MAP for ANALYTICAL-QUOTIENT-CODOMAIN-AUTHORITY-01, written at actual status. It is a RECORD, not a certification: it names, per acceptance criterion, which sub-claims a specific test, artifact or commit establishes on the pinned worktree tip, which are open with a named counterexample, and which are unexecuted with nothing to reuse. The CLI evidence block on the spec carries pass/unchecked per criterion and is the close authority; this file carries the finer grain the CLI status cannot express. Every expensive result is one of: OBSERVED on the pinned tip, REUSED from a named execution with the inputs it depended on shown unchanged, or UNEXECUTED. No result here is claimed for an integration candidate: none exists yet.
